about.title: Loggex-Machina
about.subtitle: Comprehensive Academic Management Platform
about.description: Loggex is a comprehensive academic management platform designed for educational centers. It allows managing users, centers, itineraries, subjects, groups, enrollments, schedules, attendance, assignments, syllabi and messaging, providing a modern and customizable experience.
about.featureDynamicThemeDesc: Theming system that allows each center to customize interface colors and styles in real time.
about.featureMultilangDesc: Support for Spanish, English, Catalan, Galician and Basque with real-time language switching.
about.featureSoftDeleteDesc: Logical deletion to preserve historical data integrity.
about.featureGranularSecurityDesc: Role-based access control (SuperAdmin, Admin, Teacher, Student) and automatic data filtering by center.
about.featureAttendanceDesc: Session-based attendance recording with visual calendar and per-student statistics.
about.featureMessagingDesc: Internal messaging and announcements system with file attachment support via MinIO.
about.featureVisualSchedulerDesc: Drag-and-drop schedule editor built with dnd-kit: place teachings on the weekly grid with real-time validation and visual feedback.
about.featurePdfExportDesc: Printable report cards and schedules generated via dompdf, signed by the corresponding staff member.
about.featureDigitalSignatureDesc: Vector signature capture with perfect-freehand for report cards and official documents.
about.tagline: A modern, theme-aware, multilingual academic platform
about.featureRealTimeDesc: Mercure pushes new messages to the browser via Server-Sent Events, with async jobs on Symfony Messenger workers and a Redis cache. No polling: chat feels instant and the database breathes.
about.featureOfficialCatalogDesc: Itineraries and subjects pre-loaded from BOE, TodoFP and regional bulletins: ~230 programs and ~2,230 modules with official codes, normative references and provenance trail to audit every ingest.
about.featureTerritorialCalendarDesc: Regional resolutions of school year start/end by stage, holidays by scope (national/regional/provincial/local) and a regional curriculum overlay on top of the national catalog.
about.catalogScopeValue: Full national + regional catalog (~230 programs · ~2,230 subjects)
about.erCtaText: Browse the 31 domain entities and their relations with an interactive diagram: zoom, search and a per-entity detail panel.

aboutEr.title: Entity-Relationship Model
aboutEr.subtitle: Complete database schema of Loggex: 31 Doctrine entities grouped by functional domain, with every backend field, key and relationship. Drag the canvas to explore and click any entity to view its detail card.

acerca.title: About the official catalog
acerca.subtitle: Where the data comes from, how it is updated and what guarantees it offers.
acerca.scopeDescription: Loggex keeps a local, queryable copy of the national Vocational Training catalog, automatically fed from official State sources.
acerca.scopeItem1: Programs of FP Básica, Grado Medio, Grado Superior and Cursos de Especialización.
acerca.scopeItem2: Subjects of each program, with code, total hours, weekly hours, ECTS credits and year (when the source provides them).
acerca.scopeItem3: Title identification: name, professional family, level, total duration and BOE normative reference.
acerca.sourcesDescription: The sync runs in two layers, in this order:
acerca.source1Name: TodoFP — Spanish Ministry of Education portal
acerca.source1Description: Provides the full index of programs, their level/stage and the URL to the Royal Decree at the BOE. Source of the program catalog.
acerca.source2Description: Provides the structured detail of each title (subjects, hours, ECTS) by extracting the XML of the corresponding Royal Decree or the EDU Order of the curriculum.
acerca.refreshDescription: The sync is manual or scheduled. The system is idempotent: if the BOE data has not changed since the last read, nothing is modified in the database. If there are differences, records are updated and a trace is left in the operations log. A program identity is preserved by its BOE URL, allowing the official code to evolve without losing history.
acerca.limit1: The national catalog is synced, but variations by Autonomous Community (LOE/LOMLOE adapted curricula) are not yet ingested. Planned for a later phase.
acerca.limit2: Royal Decrees that only modify an existing title (instead of defining it) may end up incomplete. These cases are documented as a v1.1 limitation.
acerca.limit3: The official list of educational centers is not yet synced. The "Official centers" section is only accessible to super-administrators and shows implementation status.
acerca.legalText: Loggex is not the official source of the displayed information. In case of discrepancy with the Spanish Official Gazette or with the information published by the Ministry of Education, the original source always prevails. This view exists only as an internal consultation tool for center administrators.
